components.label: Get file content
components.calculateValue: var d = data || {}; var v = d['pv:fileRead']; if (v === undefined && d.pv) { v = d.pv['fileRead']; } value = (v === undefined || v === null) ? '(geen data)' : (typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v, null, 4));
